Name: NHL Tracker
Author: Packrat

Actions.Name: Team Score
Actions.Tooltip: Live score for your team, with a countdown to the next score when none is on. Press to refresh, or set it to open the game page.

Actions.Name: Standings
Actions.Tooltip: Where your team sits in the conference or its division. Press to swap the view.

Actions.Name: League Scoreboard
Actions.Tooltip: Every game playing today on one key, live games first. Press for the next one.

Description: Keep the game on your deck. Live scores, start times, and where your team stands, updating on their own while you play or stream. No alt-tabbing to check the score. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the NHL or any team.
